allowed.reason: Pre-authentication code injection via the ChromaDB HTTP server (malicious model repository with trust_remote_code). Aliases: CVE-2026-45829, GHSA-f4j7-r4q5-qw2c. zk-chat uses chromadb only as the embedded chromadb.PersistentClient (zk_chat/chroma_gateway.py) and never starts the Chroma HTTP server, so this attack surface does not exist. Accepted by Stacey 2026-09-25. chromadb 1.5.9 is the latest release and OSV records it as last_affected, so no fixed version exists; re-check at expiry.
